scope: FIRST author only; no approval or promotion

figures.justification: The instructional task is inspection of clocks as locations, central emission, light paths, and inertial frames. Spacecraft identity is supplied by the complete edition prose and is not an identification/counting task. No pictorial spacecraft is rendered; the rigid endpoint/frame relationships are expressed directly. Clock circles are conventional apparatus symbols with no invented dial readings, not generated natural artwork.
figures.excludedPictorialDetails: Hull outline, projecting fins, and illegible clock-face marks are acknowledged source pixels but are not mathematical givens. They are omitted, not replaced with vector vehicle art.
figures.semanticArtworkBoundary: If a later review establishes that pictorial spacecraft recognition is required, that figure must change route to hybrid and HOLD for explicit artwork authority; no fabricated SVG ship or paid fallback is authorized here.
figures.sourceFactsVsRegularizations: Each FigureSpec source.inventory description and the independently frozen pixel inventory separate observations, text-derived identities, and explicit schematic regularization.

physics.K1: Spacecraft rest frame: central source and stationary clocks, equal distances and common c.
physics.K: Common-K-time snapshots: both light fronts travel equal distances from the emission location at c while the spacecraft endpoints move right.
physics.catchup: Unequal gaps and approach/recession are geometric relative-motion effects; no c+v or c-v is labelled as inertial light speed.
physics.constructionValues: All coordinates are undisplayed schematic layout units. No numerical physical givens or answer-key data were added.
